feature.name: Dotenv parse and set_key core
feature.description: Extract .env file parsing with quote/escape handling, POSIX variable expansion, and set_key file mutation without importing dotenv.
included_behaviors: parse key=value pairs from stream with export prefix and comments
single- and double-quoted values with escape sequences
UTF-8 BOM stripping at file start
set_key creates or updates keys with auto-quoting
excluded_behaviors: load_dotenv os.environ side effects in hidden tests

entanglement.description: Dotenv parsing couples regex-driven lexer state, quote escape tables, ordered variable resolution against prior bindings, and atomic file rewrite for set_key.
signals: parse_stream Reader position tracks multiline quoted values
resolve_variables merges os.environ with parsed order
set_key rewrites file preserving unrelated lines and newlines

output.import: import featurelifted; from featurelifted import dotenv_values, set_key, get_key

behaviors.text: The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: parse key=value pairs from stream with export prefix and comments. Required observable cases include dotenv values simple pairs; dotenv values export prefix; inline comment after whitespace; key without value is none.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: single- and double-quoted values with escape sequences. Required observable cases include dotenv values quoted value; double quote escape sequences; single quote escape only backslash and quote.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: UTF-8 BOM stripping at file start. Required observable cases include utf8 bom stripped.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: POSIX ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} variable interpolation. Required observable cases include variable interpolation chain; variable default when missing.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: set_key creates or updates keys with auto-quoting. Required observable cases include set key creates file; set key updates existing; set key quotes special characters; set key appends without trailing newline.
The package exposes the required task API paths `featurelifted.dotenv_values`, `featurelifted.set_key`, `featurelifted.get_key` with the kinds and callable signatures listed in this contract.

exclusions: load_dotenv os.environ side effects in hidden tests
